provenance.temperature_ev: Reported slow scan value, fixed by data owner; local Maxwellian proxy.
provenance.density_m3: Data-owner prescribed density, 2026-11-16; not inferred from these waveforms.
provenance.ion_energy: Cold singly charged xenon, negligible injection energy; half of 200 eV gained at the sampling location, per data owner.
provenance.acceleration_length: Data-owner accepted estimate: 100 V over 1 cm, with 0.5 and 2 cm sensitivity; average field used as a local-field proxy, not measured.
provenance.geometry: Field magnitudes used with positive axial/radial model components. Wave vector in field coordinates: ky*ey + tan(angle)*ky*es + k_parallel*eb; es lies in the axial-radial plane perpendicular to B. The 15 degree perpendicular-plane tilt is an explicit unmeasured closure, not the paper's axial angle. 0 and 30 degrees are separate sensitivity scenarios.
provenance.electron_drift: Magnitude E_axial*B_radial/|B|^2; +y is chosen along ExB. Its identification with C1-to-C3 remains assumed. No parallel electron bulk drift or pressure-gradient drift included.
provenance.ions: Axial beam response uses omega-k_axial*u_i; no ion temperature broadening.
provenance.branch: Continue the positive ion-frame acoustic root; opposite ion-frame branch also audited. Not an exhaustive enumeration of all kinetic roots.
provenance.normalization: Same nominal resistor conversion for both probes; no per-probe RMS or peak matching, no unverified DC normalization. Current units are nominal MHz response only. Source Q/T absolute normalization unresolved.
